contributions.anchor: Form A's own printed grand total at the foot of its CONTINUATION sheet, $10,791.34, which equals the cover's 'Totals for This Report' line-1 cell (10,791.34)
contributions.detail: A two-sheet schedule with NO per-sheet subtotal — p112 carries 42 rows and p113 continues with 15 more, and the only printed total is the $10,791.34 at the foot of p113, so the gate is the multi-sheet sum against that grand total. p112's 42 rows sum to 7,216.34; p113's 15 rows sum to 3,575.00; 7,216.34 + 3,575.00 = 10,791.34 = the printed grand total = the cover's This-Report line-1 cell. Cumulative is 60,380.26 over a Totals-from-Last-Report of 49,588.92 (60,380.26 - 49,588.92 = 10,791.34, so the cover's own arithmetic confirms the period scope); the prior 49,588.92 is NOT itemized on this document. Row-count gate: 42 measured bands on p112 and 15 on p113, matching the 42 and 15 rows read. 2024 is the 3-line form variant (a single 'contributions from all donors' cell, no separate <=$50 aggregate line), so the whole published This-Report contributions figure is anchored here — note that 12 of the 57 rows are $50.00 or less and the filer itemized them anyway.

expenditures.anchor: Form B's own printed total, -$15,325.20, which equals the cover's 'Totals for This Report' line-2 cell, printed there as (15,325.20)
expenditures.detail: 31 Form B rows, EVERY ONE printed in accounting parentheses. Their absolute values sum to 15,325.20 and, kept negative as printed, they sum to -15,325.20 = the schedule's own printed total (-$15,325.20) = the cover's This-Report line-2 cell (15,325.20). Cumulative is (51,138.72) over a Totals-from-Last-Report of (35,813.52), and 51,138.72 - 35,813.52 = 15,325.20, so the cover's own arithmetic confirms the period scope; the prior 35,813.52 is not itemized here. Line 3 closes: 10,791.34 - 15,325.20 = (4,533.86), the printed This-Report ending balance, and 13,775.40 - 4,533.86 = 9,241.54, the printed cumulative balance. Row-count gate: 31 measured bands, 31 rows read.

Eight were GEOMETRY proofs at the first, a middle and the last row of each schedule sheet, which is what validates the band series used on each page: p112 rows 1/13/42 reproduced $40.90 / $500.00 / $100.00; p113 rows 1/15 reproduced $500.00 / $50.00; p114 rows 1/20/31 reproduced ($1,180.00) / ($19.40) / ($3.50). All three sheets are typed and no amount needed a legibility escalation.

itemized.notes: Steven Van Wagoner, 'County Commission, Seat C', 2024 cycle, the 'October 29' box ticked, signed October 29, 2024. FOUR pages: cover p111, Form A p112 CONTINUING onto p113, Form B p114 — page order is form order, all three schedule sheets are PORTRAIT (not the rotated landscape form used by several other filers in this corpus), and all are typed. By a wide margin the largest filing in this chunk: 57 contribution rows and 31 expenditure rows for a single 20-day reporting window. ⚠ TWO SOURCE PROPERTIES THE READER MUST RESPECT. (1) THE CONTRIBUTION SCHEDULE IS A TWO-SHEET CONTINUATION WITH NO PER-SHEET SUBTOTAL: p112 runs to the bottom of the page and p113 resumes with no column header of its own and no page number, printing the single grand total $10,791.34 at its foot. The reconciliation gate is therefore the multi-sheet sum against that grand total, not a page subtotal, and p112 alone (7,216.34) must never be quoted as the schedule's figure. (2) EVERY EXPENDITURE AMOUNT IS PRINTED IN ACCOUNTING PARENTHESES and the schedule's own total prints as -$15,325.20; the cover carries the same convention on line 2 in all three columns. The parentheses are this filing's SIGN CONVENTION for spending, not 31 reversals, and per the frozen per-row rule a parenthesised figure is kept negative — so every expenditure row here carries a negative amount and the side sums to -15,325.20, which is exactly the figure the document prints and exactly the value the module's own stated-totals cache already holds for this filing. Anyone aggregating expenditures across Weber filings must handle the sign; the absolute value of this side is 15,325.20. Both schedules are PERIOD-scoped behind a cumulative cover (49,588.92 of prior contributions and 35,813.52 of prior spending are carried forward and itemized nowhere on this document). Two donor City cells are TRUNCATED BY THE SOURCE at the cell border ('Marriott-Slate' on p112 row 42, 'SHAKER HEIGH' on p113 row 11); both were re-read at 900 dpi, both are genuinely cut off in the print, and neither was completed by inference. This is the ONE filing in the chunk whose Form A prints City / State / Zip as their OWN COLUMNS rather than inside a single Address cell, so donor_city and donor_state here are read directly rather than parsed out of an address; the street-address column is still not carried (PRIVACY.md). The candidate's street address and two phone numbers print in the clear on the cover — the county applied NO redaction to this filing, unlike others in the same 2024 archive — and are deliberately not carried. Note a printed-form defect in the source: the 2024 cover's December-5 checkbox text says 'through December 31, 2022' (the county reused the 2022 form text); it is unticked here and affects no figure.
